title: ViewerAnswer
description: The answer the phone companion shows. value is computed by code from the cited evidence, never by a model; the Companion agent only words text. Mirrors ninety.agents.contracts.Answer.

status.description: Only verified answers show their text; held means still being checked.

metric.description: The stat the value is, e.g. distance_m or top_speed_kmh.

evidence.description: Event and fact ids behind the answer.

t_from.description: Start of the stretch of match the answer covers, in seconds.

visual.description: Optional: what the phone draws beside the answer, taken by code from the first cited insight fact that has one; null or absent draws nothing.
